items.difficulty_reason: Representable sheaves h_{V'}, h_W with the gluing isomorphism alpha on E; lemma-glue-etale-sheaf-modification (sheaf version, same wave) produces the glued sheaf F on Y; the sheaf-gives-space lemma turns F into an etale V -> Y; the set-theoretic condition verification is footnoted (F's condition follows from those of G and G'); the sheaf isomorphisms translate back to scheme isomorphisms V' ≅ V x_Y Y' and W ≅ V x_Y Z compatible with alpha.
